name: Haematology & blood disorders (category guide)
summary: Anaemia / clotting / abnormal blood counts — GP repeats vs haematologist, and why executive ‘full blood’ packages are not a work-up.
body: Haematologists manage anaemia, clotting disorders, cytopenias, and many abnormal full blood count patterns. A single ‘weird blood result’ on a wellness screen usually needs GP repeat labs and context before a private haematology package. Easy bruising, unexplained lymphadenopathy, or progressive cytopenias need timely medical review — not Instagram anaemia influencers. Public hospital private-patient paths exist; foreigners pay full fees. Corporate riders may cover specialist consults while specialised assays need pre-auth. Distinct from health-screening lab category listings. Category guide, not a ranked haematologist list.
